reviews.t: This scent will make you a father.
reviews.x: I'd give this scent 6* if I could. Starts slightly spicy n woodsy n finishes w/sweet vanilla notes. Enough in the bottle for a couple wears, definitely enough for me to know I was comfy spending the extra keish on the full bottle. This scent by MMM def warrants the price tag.

these are samples with very little product inside but this was less than a sample size. I had never bought from this vendor who has a 100% rating & will not again. 1 star because I received it -4 for GlobalBeautyBuy

Although it's unisex, I would consider it more of a masculine scent.  I spent some time in a Sephora going through the line up and this is the most fall/winter of their scents.  Deep vanilla, bourbon, and wood is what I pick up and really enjoy, can't wait till summer is over now!! Quick shipping and product was exactly what was stated!!  Will surely buy from this seller again!!

reviews.t: Welp, I am 1 for 2 with the replica fragrance line
reviews.x: I love deep manly musky smells. I’ve been wearing polo green my whole life and this is my first change. I bought a full bottle of  “at the barbers” blind. I can guess what it would smell like and took the chance. Love it! Now I’m intrigued in this fragrance line.  I bought a sampler of the ever popular “by the fireplace”. What a bust. I was expecting Smokey, dark, musky, chestnut type smell. NOPE. I had to double check the packaging to make sure I got the right product. It is over powering Vanil

reviews.t: Can't believe I paid $14 for this!
reviews.x: My daughter tried this at Sephora and loved it and it is expensive so I thought this would be a good stocking stuffer size for her as it advertised "Deluxe Travel Size"  not, sample size.  Travel size and sample size are two different things.  I tried to return it but it's non-returnable.  I am not happy at all.  I could have just went to Sephora and got a free sample and saved myself $14!  Not at all happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: Not worth the price - Came half full
reviews.x: Of the hundreds of products I've purchased off of Amazon, this is the first time I've ever been compelled to leave a review.  First, let me say the scent is amazing. But I knew that prior to purchasing this since a friend introduced it to me. My issue lies with how much came in the provided bottle for the price they charged. It was half empty and less than what you would get for free as a sample. This was a total ripoff.

I'm used to maisone Margiela testers being filled nearly to the top, but mine was only about 2/3rds full. It bothers me because I really do love the scent more than any other fragrance and was expecting it to be like the other testers ive gotten from them. Luckily a little bit goes a long way, but I wish I got more for what I paid.

The container arrived about 60% full, I’m not sure if some of the contents leaked out in transport but it appears the vile wasn’t full. When you spend a little under $20 for a sample and it comes a little over half full, it doesn’t make you excited to purchase the product again.
Although not much for the money,  you can get an idea of how it smells and length of time it stays on you. A nice, not over powering scent that lingers. Definitely will buy larger size.
Great winter, cozy scent. Strong vanilla and spice scent that reminds you of exactly what it says...being by the fireplace.

I hate this. It smells nothing like a fireplace and just smells like dollar store cologne. It stinks and gave me a migraine. I instantly threw it away. But everyone’s taste is different. I just expected it to be less musky and cologne like and more like the actual smell of a fireplace.

Smells a lot more sweet than I was anticipating. I was hoping it would have more of a crisp scent. Very tiny. Scent does not last long at all. I was given a free gift, another fragrance and it actually smells much better.

A bit expensive, but I do enjoy wearing it. It is a “unisex“ scent I think. It’s very unique, not what you’d expect. But I get a lot of compliments on it and it is not overwhelming.
Cost effective opportunity to trial an ordinarily expensive cologne. Unisex, well described as rustic and firewood.
Paid too much for this sample size bottle, received it and it was almost empty. Glad I was able to get a refund.
I absolutely love the scent. I knew that going in... But I was disappointed at the amount of product.

reviews.x: Product is a sample size. Usually handed out free. Charging $16 is ludicrous. Disappointed.
I bought a sample and will purchase a full size. This has an awesomely-vibrant scent.
The scent is fine, not for me, but this is the size of a free sample.  Not worth $15.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the bottle arrives only partially full, often around half to two-thirds, which they find disappointing for the price.
Reviewers frequently praise the scent itself, describing it as a warm, cozy, vanilla-and-spice fragrance that lingers.
Several customers feel the sample size is poor value for the money, especially compared to free samples from stores.
A few reviewers note the scent leans masculine and musky, which some enjoy while others find it cologne-like and overpowering.
Some reviewers mention the sample provides enough for a few wears and helps them decide whether to buy the full bottle.
